sessions.topic: Cluster-conditioned invariance and the Waterbirds accuracy test
sessions.boundary_reason: Waterbirds results support advancing the approach to multi-dataset validation.

sessions.topic: CelebA edit audit and a test of within-cluster shortcut identification
sessions.boundary_reason: The identification test falls short, prompting a different approach.

sessions.topic: Independent-edit paired loss compared with cluster invariance and ERM
sessions.boundary_reason: The CelebA comparison establishes the paired-loss result and raises a new robustness question.

sessions.topic: Paired-loss sensitivity to edit artifacts correlated with minority cues
sessions.boundary_reason: Held-out tests establish a crossover and a conditional decision to advance paired loss.

sessions.topic: Audit of paired loss under low artifact–minority-cue correlation
sessions.boundary_reason: The stratified CelebA audit is produced before the discussion shifts to correcting higher-correlation artifacts.
The CelebA comparison reports the correction’s accuracy before a distinct mask-based proposal begins.

sessions.topic: Tuning sham-calibrated masks to preserve minority cues and suppress shortcuts
sessions.boundary_reason: Held-out attribution results support adopting validation-tuned masks.

sessions.topic: Extending tuned-mask edit audits to Waterbirds
sessions.boundary_reason: The expanded audit is produced before a new orbit-prototype approach is proposed.

sessions.topic: Orbit prototypes and their initial Waterbirds evaluation
sessions.boundary_reason: The initial accuracy result leads to a question about sparse rare-cluster edit orbits.

sessions.topic: Rare-cluster orbit counts and cross-cluster shrinkage
sessions.boundary_reason: The evidence yields a minimum-orbit decision and rejects shrinkage on cue-retention grounds.

sessions.topic: Expanded Waterbirds orbit audit and certification gates
